description: Google Search Console is Google's service for monitoring how websites perform in Google Search, including search analytics, sitemaps, site properties, and URL inspection. The product lets site owners review indexing and search traffic data for their verified properties.
summary: search.google.com exposes one developer integration surface: the Google Search Console HTTP API, documented at developers.google.com and served from searchconsole.googleapis.com, authenticated primarily with Google OAuth 2.0 and with API-key support documented for Testing Tools/public endpoints.
